messages:
emma: Heads-up - hit a tenant case where console unmask wrote ~12GB of embeddings outputs to persistent store. We need a safer default for inspect + quota credits.

ryan: Oof. Was this from bulk-embed endpoint? We should treat that as no-persist by default unless explicit opt-in.

jess: Agreed. Proposal: require a preflight `inspect/preview` and enforce per-tenant inspect credits. Default persist sampling = 1%.

emma: sketch config: 
`inspect.defaults.persist_rate=0.01` 
`inspect.endpoints_blocklist=["/v1/embeddings","/v1/bulk/*"]` 
`inspect.tenant_daily_credits=100`

ryan: soft_block vs hard_block? UX wise soft_block returns redacted preview + CTA to request exception. Hard block = 403. Soft sounds less disruptive.

jess: soft_block + audit flow. Also require a two-step for bulk jobs: preview diff + typed acknowledgement.

emma: security: handles for unmask must be single-use HMAC tokens, TTL 2m, origin-checked. Store only handle hash server-side.

ryan: telemetry hooks: `inspect.preview.called`, `inspect.handle.issued`, `inspect.unmask.executed`, `inspect.persisted.bytes`. Tag with tenant_hash, model, route.

jess: redaction-first rule: always run scrubbers (PII heuristics + attachment stripper) before any sampling or persistence. If redactor fails, block and page SRE.

samir: infra-bot: added checklist to deploy notes: feature-flag `inspect_guardrails`, preview endpoint, attachment extractor, sampling toggles, alert on redact-failure.

emma: alert thresholds: if any tenant's inspect persisted bytes > 3x monthly median for 24h, auto-suspend inspect and notify SRE. Also page on redact.failures > 0.

ryan: retention: sampled raw payloads TTL=30d for canary, 90d for GA. Hashes/provenance indefinite (for audits).

jess: allowlist: enable per-tenant route allowlist only after legal + contract flag; when enabled, require additional caps and audit note.

emma: rollout: canary 5% tenants with preview-only console, enforce blocklist, 1% sample. Measure burn and redact-failures for 2 weeks before expanding.

ryan: ownership: jess takes redaction + extractor, samir infra handles tokens & sampling, i'll wire telemetry + alerts. emma will draft RFC and UI wires.

emma: I'll open RFC tonight + attach minimal console mock (preview diff, credits badge). Ping for reviews.

infra-bot: quick commands to set flags: `SET FEATURE inspect_guardrails=true`, `SET CONFIG inspect.defaults.persist_rate=0.01`, `CREATE ALERT inspect.persisted.burn_spike`

jess: will add fuzz tests for base64/pdf attachments and a redactor smoke test.

ryan: added dashboard placeholders and a sim-run to validate caps against a 10k bulk job.

emma: thanks team - actionable. Let's aim 5% canary next Tuesday and recon Friday for metrics.
